'''2007 Worlds Team David McCune LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Days Inn. Deck title Leia Likes Han's Popsicle. 10 shields on sheet.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
